about.title: About the Store
about.subtitle: Tech you can trust: an online store with offline showrooms, a 2-year warranty and next-day delivery.
about.trustTitle: We sell what we use ourselves
about.trustText: We have been selling smartphones, laptops, audio and photography gear since 2018. Every device can be seen and tried in our showroom, and before you buy you get honest advice with no upselling.
about.ctaText: We'll tell you about delivery, warranty and returns — we're here every day.
about.metaDescription: Online tech store since 2018: offline showrooms, 2-year warranty, next-day delivery, 14-day returns and round-the-clock support.
about.b1Text: We add one more year on top of the manufacturer's standard warranty — at our expense, with no service fees.
about.b2Text: See, touch and compare devices in person — just like in a regular store.
about.b3Text: Courier to your door or a pickup point. Orders placed before 6 PM ship the same day.
about.b4Text: Not a fit? We'll refund you, no questions asked. The item just needs to stay in marketable condition.
about.b5Text: Pay online by card with payment protection, or in cash on delivery — whichever suits you.
about.b6Text: Chat, phone and email — we reply within 15 minutes during business hours.
about.s1Text: A catalog with honest specifications and real photos. Unsure? We'll advise you in chat.
about.s2Text: Two minutes to place an order: courier or pickup point delivery, online payment or cash on delivery.
about.s3Text: Inspect the device upon delivery — the courier or pickup-point clerk waits and helps.
about.s4Text: 2-year warranty and support 7 days a week. If anything happens — we fix it at our expense.
